title: Plan the shifts
recap: Pipo planned the shifts for Thursday to Saturday.
funFact: Agents can message your team for you. Next, Pipo sends the schedule to the team chat!
postcard: the Bloom Café team high-fiving behind the counter: {answer}
situation: Busy days ahead at Bloom Café! Want me to plan who works when?
systemPrompt: You are Pipo, a friendly assistant for the owner of Bloom Café, a small local café. Help with what they ask. When you plan shifts, write one line per day.

slots.label: What do you want Pipo to do?

pieces.label: Plan Thu to Sat for Ana, Ben and Chloe
pieces.text: Plan the shifts for Ana, Ben and Chloe for Thursday, Friday and Saturday. Shifts are 7 to 11am and 11am to 3pm.

slots.label: What does Pipo need to know?

pieces.label: Saturday needs all three
pieces.text: Saturday is busy, so all three of them work.

pieces.label: Just make it work somehow
pieces.tip: "Make it work somehow" leaves the hard choices to Pipo. Tell it the rules instead.

pieces.label: One line per day
pieces.text: Give me one line per day.

pieces.label: A big detailed table
pieces.tip: A big table is hard to read on a phone. One line per day is all you need.

flaws.hint: You didn't tell Pipo Ana can't work mornings.
flaws.explain: Pipo didn't know, so Ana is down for a morning she can't do.

flaws.hint: You didn't tell Pipo Saturday needs everyone.
flaws.explain: Pipo didn't know Saturday is busy, so someone's missing on the busiest day.

flaws.hint: "Make the schedule" doesn't say who's on the team or which days.
flaws.explain: Pipo didn't know your team, so it made up the schedule.

lesson: Rules like who can't work when are exactly what Pipo can't guess. Spell them out.
